description: We r AstroQuant Saudi, a team from Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University who love using math, coding and curiosity to understand our world. We're building ClimateTrend Saudi to explore changes in temperature and rainfall using NASA data and R. We bring skills in statistics, research and problem-solving, and we'd love to work with students interested in R,maps, design or writing. We believe that U don't need to be an expert,just curious, reliable and ready to learn and build something useful.
